from QUOTATION h
left join BIZ_PARTNER p on h.partner_id = p.partner_id
left join WAREHOUSE w on h.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
left join ASSIGNEE a on h.assignee_id = a.assignee_id
mapper.select:
select quotation_id, quotation_no, business_date, partner_id, partner_code, partner_name, assignee_id, assignee_code, assignee_name, warehouse_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, note, updated_at, deleted_yn, progress_status, item_summary, total_amount from (select ROWNUM rn, ordered_quotation.* from (select
order by h.business_date DESC, h.quotation_id DESC) ordered_quotation where ROWNUM <= #{page} * #{pageSize}) where rn > (#{page} - 1) * #{pageSize} order by sort_business_date DESC, quotation_id DESC

select l.quotation_line_id, l.quotation_id, l.item_id, i.item_code, l.item_name, l.specification, l.unit, l.quantity, l.unit_price, l.supply_amount, l.vat_amount, l.total_amount, l.note, l.deleted_yn from QUOTATION_LINE l join quotation h on h.quotation_id = l.quotation_id left join item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where l.quotation_id = #{quotationId} and l.deleted_yn = 'N' and h.deleted_yn = 'N' order by l.quotation_line_id ASC
mapper.insert:
select seq_quotation.nextval from dual
insert into QUOTATION (quotation_id, quotation_no, business_date, partner_id, partner_name, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, assignee_id, assignee_name, note) values (#{quotationId}, LPAD(TO_CHAR(#{quotationId}), GREATEST(5, LENGTH(TO_CHAR(#{quotationId}))), '0'), TO_DATE(#{businessDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{partnerId}, #{partnerName}, #{warehouseId}, #{warehouseName}, #{assigneeId}, #{assigneeName}, #{note})

select seq_quotation_line.nextval from dual
insert into QUOTATION_LINE (quotation_line_id, quotation_id, item_id, item_name, specification, unit, quantity, unit_price, supply_amount, vat_amount, note, total_amount) values (#{quotationLineId}, #{quotationId}, #{itemId}, #{itemName}, #{specification}, #{unit}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{supplyAmount}, #{vatAmount}, #{note}, #{totalAmount})
mapper.update: update QUOTATION set business_date = TO_DATE(#{businessDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), partner_id = #{partnerId}, partner_name = #{partnerName}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, warehouse_name = #{warehouseName}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, assignee_name = #{assigneeName}, note = #{note}, updated_at = LOCALTIMESTAMP where quotation_id = #{quotationId} and deleted_yn = 'N'
